name: Miko wa Kyouen no Naka ni
source:
Main character is a university professor who fails to motivate his students. But his new research is going to change everything. He goes to a certain island and insults and interrogates ladies of the island who are all shrine maidens to approach the core of the mystery.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-october-2002-rocket-no-natsu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名大学教授，始终无法激发学生的学习热情。然而，他的新研究将改变一切。他前往某座岛屿，为接近谜团核心，对岛上全为巫女的女性加以羞辱并进行审问。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-october-2002-rocket-no-natsu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
